nonop.text: Interest expense for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 was $76.6 million, compared with $67.5 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2024, due to an increase in our average cost of debt. lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Approximately 5.3% and 5.1% of our revenue was generated in Canada for fiscal 2026 and 2025, respectively.
Our business plan relies upon a network of independent dealers strategically located throughout the United States and Canada.
We may also need to depend upon third party providers for some of those services, and they may not be able to provide workable solutions.
We rely on information technology systems to manage and support our operations and provide products, services, and support to our customers.
Our ability to make payments on our debt and leases depends upon our ability to maintain and improve our operating performance and generate cash flow.

As described in this Annual Report, we rely upon our “controlled company” status to permit our full Board to nominate directors rather than delegate that responsibility to the independent directors or a nominations committee comprised of independent directors.
In the future we may rely upon our status as a “controlled company” to not comply with other governance standards.
The timing and amount of stock repurchases, if any, will depend on price, market conditions, applicable regulatory requirements, and other factors.
